## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Starts modifying how much damage one or more receivers will receive from one or more damagers. A reference to this damage modification can be obtained from the [Last Damage Modification ID](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/last%2Bdamage%2Bmodification%2Bid) value. This action will fail if too many damage modifications have been started.
			
### Notes
* A maximum of 64 damage modifications can be active at once.
* Unlike [Set Damage Dealt](/wiki/articles/set+damage+dealt), Damage Modifications only affect damage to players (and not player owned objects like barriers and turrets).

## Snippet

```
Start Damage Modification(Event Player, All Players(All Teams), 0, Receivers, Damagers, And Damage Percent);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Receivers_==, ==_Damagers_==, ==_Damage Percent_==, ==_Reevaluation_==

> ==**Receivers**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The player or players whose incoming damage will be modified (when attacked by the damagers).

> ==**Damagers**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[All Players](/wiki/articles/all+players)**_
> The player or players whose outgoing damage will be modified (when attacking the receivers).

> ==**Damage Percent**==
> _Type: **Float**, Default: **[Number](/wiki/articles/number)**_
> The percentage of damage that will apply to receivers when attacked by damagers.

> ==**Reevaluation**==
> _Type: **DamageReeval**, Default: **Receivers, Damagers, And Damage Percent**_
> Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
````
